actual_scope: Dense-polar threshold law screens at T = 7 and T = 8 plus an exhaustive overcomplete one-extra rank-one census at small T. Model as in PR 2272/PR 2125: root lines p(t) = q(t) in Q^T, full-orthogonal-pattern pairing B0 (unit diagonal, ones exactly on orthogonal pairs), exact coordinate Gram decoder M = sum_j p_j q_j^T = Gram, cost = sum_j rank_F2 B[R_j, A_j], gain means cost < v. Part 1 (mandatory positive control): the engine reproduces PR 2272's checked table D4/D5/D6 = 12/20/30, E6 = 36 (stored basis + stored B) and 37 (first-independent basis, B0), E7 = 49, E8 = 72 before any new number is trusted. Part 2: exact full-system costs at T = 7 (A7, B7, C7, D7, E7, {0,+/-1}^7) and T = 8 (A8, B8, C8, D8, {0,+/-1}^8) under the checked decoder and B0, with seeded bounded basis pivots and puncture searches declared as bounded. Part 3: the overcomplete m = T + 1 one-extra rank-one frame identity of PR 2240 (p_i = X e_i, q_i = X(H e_i - lambda a_i a), p_{T+1} = X a, q_{T+1} = lambda X a) censused exactly over every subset (puncture) of the T = 3 {0,+/-1}^3 set (13 lines) and of D4 (12 lines), all projective {-1,0,1}^T directions, and every rational lambda support cell.
ai_assistance: with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed)
author: Aaron Wang
bottleneck_link: The dense-polar T^2 law and the ideal-decoder formula price the local root-decoder words that feed the complex and bit suppliers; PR 2272 closed T <= 6 for the checked decoders/pairings and left T >= 7, overcomplete (m = T + 1) decoders and pairing minima on its 1,023 cost = v ties open. A T >= 7 gain changes what larger-T decoder interfaces can cost; a scoped negative extends the closed regime to T = 7/8 and to overcomplete punctures at small T, narrowing the three remaining gaps of the rank-3/decoder theory.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json (all counts, block ranks, seeds, direction/cell counts). Controls reproduce PR 2272 checked table 12/20/30 (D4/D5/D6), 36/37 (E6), 49 (E7), 72 (E8) and A4-A6 16/25/36 exactly, with B=I mutation controls. T = 7/8 screens: no new gain (only in-table E7 49 < 63 and E8 72 < 120); B7/B8 tie at v = T^2 exactly; {0,+/-1}^7 cost 4501 vs v 1093, {0,+/-1}^8 cost 15760 vs v 3280. Seeded basis pivots (300 per unit) and puncture searches find min(cost - v) >= 0 outside E7. Overcomplete one-extra rank-one census: 13 full sets at T = 3..5 and 144,953 exhaustively censused punctures at T <= 4, zero gains, min(cost - v) = 0 with 2,977 ties; exact identity checks and brute-force prefilter cross-checks pass.

open_questions.blocked_by: No finite support-cell reduction over Q is known for arbitrary (p_j, q_j) factorizations; the family identities fix the frame and keep the cell problem one-dimensional in lambda.
open_questions.first_step: Enumerate the support cells of a two-direction correction family (two independent extra frames) at T = 3 and price every cell exactly.
open_questions.question: Do unrestricted (m = T + 1) factorizations outside the one-extra rank-one frame family beat v at T <= 4?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The coupling-lemma square floors fix m = T; the one-extra rank-one family is only one curve through the factorization variety, so a below-v overcomplete decoder could still exist outside it.

open_questions.blocked_by: No monotone relaxation is known; pairings must be enumerated or bounded by a rank-aware argument.
open_questions.first_step: Exact branch-and-bound over pairings B on the largest tied D7/A7 punctures found by the exhaustive census.
open_questions.question: Pairing minima on cost = v ties: can a sparser admissible B price below v on tied T = 7 punctures?
open_questions.why_it_matters: rank_F2 B[R, A] is not monotone in B; ties at B0 do not settle min over B, and a below-v pairing would be a genuine T >= 7 gain.

open_questions.blocked_by: The support pattern is not continuous in the basis; local moves can escape any greedy descent.
open_questions.first_step: Deterministic descent over basis changes on the E7 line set with exact recomputation of supports.
open_questions.question: Is the E7 basis minimum of the B0 cost exactly 49 over all GL_7(Q) bases (E6 analogue: 36 vs 37)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Cost depends on the basis; a basis below 49 would improve the first recorded gain and probe the T^2 side of the law at T = 7.
